title: Southern Hotel Apartments offers rent as low as $675 for qualifying households in downtown Laredo
excerpt: Southern Hotel Apartments in downtown Laredo is offering rent starting at $725 a month, with water included — and qualifying low-income households can pay as little as $675 a month.
content:
Southern Hotel Apartments in downtown Laredo is offering affordable rents for residents searching for housing, Hammrod News Laredo TX reported Sunday, November 8, 2026.

The apartment complex at 1210 Matamoros Street offers rent starting at $725 a month, with water included. Qualifying low-income households may receive an additional $50 monthly discount, bringing rent down to $675 a month, including water. A City of Laredo Community Development flyer lists rents from $675 to $825, with water and trash included, for studio and one-bedroom units.

Units come with refrigerators and stoves, and the complex has an on-site laundry facility and a fitness center.

Residents interested in viewing the apartments can schedule a tour by contacting Ms. Elizabeth Garcia at (956) 795-5721. Office hours are Monday through Friday, from 8 a.m. to noon and 1 p.m. to 5 p.m. Appointments after 5 p.m. are also available upon request.

Source: Hammrod News Laredo TX, November 8, 2026; City of Laredo Community Development Department flyer.
